gen-gf-iceberg-gf-pridi: Pridi reads generously, its curves leaving real space before they meet the stem. Iceberg does best at bold marker-tip statements with one flat line weight; Pridi does best at running text, its small letters standing almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-iceberg-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is a bookish serif whose rounded letters keep wide, clear openings. Slabo 13px would carry page after page without tiring, while Iceberg adds marker-tip strokes with no contrast at all up top.
gen-gf-iceberg-gf-suwannaphum: Bent copper-pipe strokes up top in Iceberg, then a tall, squared-off serif beneath. Suwannaphum would settle into a dignified, editorial rhythm, its paperclip-open c keeping every line easy going.
gen-gf-iceland-author: Iceland cuts every letter at a single depth, with no hairlines anywhere, so the heading feels engraved and commanding. Author's mellow bowls are friendliest when the text stays brief.
gen-gf-iceland-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Literary in tone, BhuTuka Expanded One slows the pace to a leisurely walk beneath Iceland's solid-block words. Tight blocks up top hand off to loose, curvy text below, unhurried.
gen-gf-iceland-gf-hepta-slab: Engraved and blocky: Iceland sets words like solid slabs, one cut depth throughout. And Hepta Slab, a serif with a paperclip-bent look and breathing counters, lets each stretched-out word relax below.
gen-gf-iceland-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Iceland cuts its letters at a single depth, narrow and block-like. Padyakke Expanded One, a serif with pitcher-mouthed c's and uniform round bowls, unspools text slowly, like knots along a slack rope.
gen-gf-imbue-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code runs a wire-like monoline skeleton with wide gaps between neighbors. Cascadia Code's open, unobstructed bends sit against Imbue's tightly packed, softly contrasted letters, and the difference is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-imbue-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board, curves as stout as the stems. Cascadia Mono's blunt marker-tip finish gives Imbue's slightly thinned diagonals something to push against.
gen-gf-imbue-gf-julius-sans-one: Imbue packs its letters almost touching, with gentle swelling on the curves, giving headings a soft editorial pulse. Imbue does dense and soft; Julius Sans One does spacious and bare.
